lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: informal arguments for circumference, area, and volume formulas
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: informal arguments for circumference, area, and volume formulas

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: Volume of a cone with radius 3 and height 4?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane parallel to its base.
A solid object has mass 34 g and volume 17 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 4 m is to be paved at $5 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $80; the cost is proportional to the area
$80; the cost is proportional to the side length
$80; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$20; the cost is proportional to the area

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 and height 6. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane perpendicular to its base through the axis.
A solid object has mass 63 g and volume 21 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 17 m is to be paved at $9 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a square pyramid with base edge 9 and height 10. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
